# Mobile UX & Accessibility Checklist: Mobile Client Support

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements-writing quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability) of the mobile touch-interaction and accessibility requirements — not whether the implementation behaves correctly.
**Created**: 2026-09-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the always-visible-vs-interactive distinction for the on-screen keypad fully specified for every selection state (no cell selected, non-given cell selected, given cell selected)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003c]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how the keypad's dimmed/disabled visual state must differ from its interactive state (e.g., opacity, color, icon)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what a screen reader announces for a disabled keypad button versus an enabled one? [Gap, Spec §FR-003b]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for keypad behavior when the viewport crosses the compact/desktop breakpoint while a cell is selected (e.g., resizing mid-interaction)? [Gap, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "visually dimmed" (Clarifications, 2026-09-14) quantified with a specific, objectively verifiable visual property, or left to implementer discretion? [Clarity, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "common tablet widths" (SC-005) quantified with a specific pixel range rather than left open-ended? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "reposition itself so it never covers the selected cell" (Edge Cases) specific enough to be objectively verified against a normal-flow (non-overlay) layout? [Clarity, Measurability]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Are the always-visible keypad requirements (FR-003, FR-003c) consistent with the Edge Case describing keypad "appearing" and needing repositioning, or does that edge case still assume the earlier appear/disappear model? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the disabled/dimmed keypad state described consistently between User Story 2's acceptance scenarios and the Functional Requirements (FR-003c) and Key Entities sections? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can SC-003's "95% of single-tap digit entries register correctly" be objectively measured given the keypad is now always rendered (including in its disabled state) rather than appearing fresh per selection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are acceptance criteria defined for confirming the keypad remains visible (not just "active"/"inactive") across a full selection/deselection cycle? [Coverage, Spec §US2 AC6]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for tapping a disabled keypad button (e.g., must it be a guaranteed no-op, or is any behavior acceptable since it's `disabled`)? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the keypad's state immediately after "Reset" is tapped while a cell was previously selected? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for what happens to the keypad's interactive/dimmed state during and immediately after "Solve All" or "Solve Next Digit" (which may change or clear the selected cell's editability)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the dimmed→interactive keypad transition's timing (e.g., "immediately") quantified, or could an implementer read it as allowing a noticeable delay? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003c]

## Non-Functional Requirements (Accessibility)

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements explicit that the always-visible keypad must remain in the tab/focus order (not `aria-hidden`) even when disabled, per the 2026-09-14 clarification's intent to keep it discoverable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003c]
- [ ] CHK016 Is there a requirement covering the accessible name/role for the keypad container itself (not just its buttons) in both its interactive and disabled states? [Gap, Spec §FR-003b]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK018 Does SC-003's exclusion of "taps on the disabled/dimmed keypad" specify whether this exclusion applies only to on-screen keypad taps, or also to any physical/paired-keyboard input received while no editable cell is selected (FR-003a)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it explicitly required that the native `disabled` attribute (or equivalent) functionally block any `PuzzleStore` mutation from a dimmed-state tap, rather than only applying a visual style with the tap still capable of mutating state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003c]
- [ ] CHK020 Does FR-003c's placement between FR-003 and FR-003a/FR-003b (out of alphabetical-suffix order) create any traceability risk for readers scanning requirements sequentially by ID? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003c]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
